State the opening in one paragraph. Name the candidate, the role or
programme they seek, and your relationship to them.

# Qualifications

State the candidate's qualifications. Give the evidence: projects,
results, and behaviours observed.

# Personal qualities

State the personal qualities. Name integrity, teamwork, and
reliability with concrete examples.

# Recommendation

State the overall recommendation. Repeat the strength of your
endorsement, then sign with your name and title.
